title: Count Vowels in a String
description: Read one complete line of text and print the number of English vowels (a, e, i, o, u), ignoring letter case.
input_format: One line of text; it may contain spaces and uppercase letters.
output_format: Print one integer: the number of vowels.

starter_code.Python:
text = input()
vowels = "aeiou"
count = 0
for char in text.lower():
    if char in vowels:
        count += 1
print(count)

learning_content.title: Strings and character traversal
learning_content.intro: A string is a sequence of characters. To count vowels without case sensitivity, convert each character to lowercase and test whether it belongs to the vowel set.
points: Read the complete input line, including spaces.
Convert each character to lowercase for comparison.
Check whether the character is a, e, i, o or u.
Increase the counter when a vowel is found.

quiz.question: Should the uppercase character E be counted as a vowel in this task?

options.label: Yes, it is counted as e after case normalization
options.feedback: The task ignores letter case, so uppercase E counts as a vowel.

options.label: No, only lowercase vowels are counted
options.feedback: The task explicitly requires case-insensitive counting.

options.label: Only when it appears at the beginning
options.feedback: Vowel counting does not depend on position.

options.label: Only when it is next to a space
options.feedback: Whitespace does not change whether a character is a vowel.

quiz.explanation: Converting characters to lowercase makes uppercase E match the vowel e.
